items.title: Applying sections of the California Vehicle Code (CVC) to West Access Road, a temporary, publicly accessible private street to be built as part of the HOPE SF Sunnydale housing development, to enable the SFMTA to enforce parking restrictions for red zones, street cleaning regulations, double parking, and other miscellaneous issues. This will support neighborhood circulation and Muni service while construction temporarily closes adjacent streets, as authorized by section 21107.5 of the CVC.
